title: fix(spec)!: an inline action refuses `confirmText` beside a non-empty `params`, as a registered action does
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzfHVbsfKWji5VLrLbG
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBN6TwTfduBnZH2gwPifJvvc)_

Fixes #29383
Ruling-ref: 6595808462

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — no `skills/**` file teaches an inline action carrying `confirmText` beside `params`. The one rule line about the pair (`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` L22, "A registered action is refused it beside a non-empty `params` (put the question on `description`)") stays true and names the remedy this refusal prescribes; the generated `content/docs/references/**` tables that render the `confirmText` describe are regenerated here.

**BREAKING** accept-set narrowing at `InlineActionSchema` (`@objectstack/spec`), served where a page's `element:button` `properties.action` is judged: the component-props gate (`component-props-invalid`, `@objectstack/lint`) at every CLI command and at the runtime `page` save door.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：页面按钮上内联声明的动作（`element:button` 的 `properties.action`）同时写 `confirmText` 和非空 `params` 时，现在和已注册动作一样被拒收，提示把这句话挪到 `description`、删掉 `confirmText`。
- 为什么改：您在 #29383 裁定 A（「同意」）。内联动作和注册动作走同一个执行器，先弹确认框、再弹参数框，一个决定两个对话框；`description` 已能写在内联动作上，作者有地方挪这句话。
- 风险与回滚：仓内普查 0 处已发运的内联动作带这对组合，只翻转 spec 自己的一条测试 pin；不带 `params` 或 `params: []` 的 `confirmText` 照常通过，批量动作不受影响。已存页面照常加载，下次保存才被拒。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`（新的共用判定 `declaresConfirmBesideParams` 与 `CONFIRM_BESIDE_PARAMS_REFUSAL`，`InlineActionSchema` 链上新增的那条 `.refine`），`packages/spec/src/ui/action-confirm-params-guard.test.ts` 末尾新的 describe 组，`.changeset/29383-inline-action-confirm-beside-params-refused.md`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ui/action-confirm-params-guard.test.ts`，预期 16 个测试全过，其中内联组 5 条（2 条拒收、3 条对照）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **One predicate, one refusal, two doors.** `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` lifts the `ActionSchema` pair rule out of its refine body into a module-level predicate, `declaresConfirmBesideParams(data)` (`confirmText != null` and `params` a non-empty array, unchanged), and a module-level refusal, `CONFIRM_BESIDE_PARAMS_REFUSAL` (the existing message, byte for byte, at path `['confirmText']`). `ActionSchema`'s refinement now reads `return !declaresConfirmBesideParams(data)` with that refusal; `InlineActionSchema` gains one `.refine` with the same two, between its target-required rule and its url-target rule. No second copy of either.
- **The comment at the refinement** no longer says the inline pair is "a separate narrowing question, not decided here". It states that `InlineActionSchema` carries the same refusal on its own chain, by ruling record 6595808462 letter A, and why (same runner, so the same two dialogs; its pick carries `description`, so the remedy has a slot).
- **The `confirmText` describe** dropped its "On a registered action," qualifier ("pairing this with a non-empty `params` is refused …"), since both doors that render this describe now refuse the pair; a view's `bulkActionDefs` declares its own `confirmText`. The NB comment above the field says so. `content/docs/references/{data/object,kernel/metadata-plugin,ui/action,ui/component}.mdx` are regenerated from it (`check:generated --fix`, which proved only `check:docs` stale).
- **Changeset** `.changeset/29383-inline-action-confirm-beside-params-refused.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor, both declaration lines, the ADR-0087 disposition marker, the narrowing banner, before / now / unchanged / who, and the remedy.

### Before / after at the inline door, on the census case

The census case is the one inline carrier the census found, the pin in `action-confirm-params-guard.test.ts`:

```ts
InlineActionSchema.safeParse({
  type: 'url', target: '/approvals?reject=1', label: 'Reject',
  confirmText: 'Reject this request?',
  params: [{ name: 'reason', label: 'Reason', type: 'textarea' }],
});
```

- **Before** (`origin/main` `b3d14150`): `success: true`, pinned by the test "InlineActionSchema is out of reach too — it picks fields, not this refine chain".
- **After** (this head): `success: false`, one issue at `['confirmText']`, `code: 'custom'`, and its message equals `ActionSchema`'s own issue for the registered pair (asserted with `toBe`). With `description` in place of `confirmText`, with no `params`, and with `params: []`, the same action parses.
- **At the authoring door.** The page component-props gate (`validateComponentProps`, `@objectstack/lint` src against this head's spec `dist`), on a page whose `element:button` carries `{ type: 'api', target: '/api/v1/approvals/reject', params: [reason], confirmText: 'Reject this request?' }`: one finding, `component-props-invalid`, severity `error`, at `pages[0].regions[0].components[0].properties.action.confirmText`, message opening "action.confirmText: An action that declares `confirmText` beside a non-empty `params` shows the user TWO dialogs for one decision". The remedy body (`description`, no `confirmText`), the param-less body and the `params: []` body: no finding.
- **`defineStack` does not judge it**, before or after: a component's `properties` is an open bag that the stack parse does not dispatch (measured: an inline `cancelText`, an inline url action with no `target`, and the pair all pass `defineStack` on this head). The changeset names the props gate as the door, not `defineStack`.

### ADR-0087 disposition

The changeset body carries the ADR-0087 marker comment with the disposition `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, the form the repo's narrowing changesets use (223 of the `.changeset/*.md` markers on `origin/main` are `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`; the closest precedents are `26413-now-anchor-extra-key-refused.md` and `26462-diff-missing-version-refused.md`). No `docs/adr/**` path is touched. The reasoning: no key is added, removed or renamed; the census found 0 shipped carriers; and the one rewrite there could be (move `confirmText` into `description`) needs the author to read the sentence, so the refusal names it and nothing converts it.

### Census, re-run at the base

At `origin/main` `b3d14150` (report 6580676225 counted at `a6441636`): every file under `examples/`, `packages/**`, `ui/**`, `skills/**`, `templates`, `apps/` carrying `confirmText` (excluding `CHANGELOG.md`), each `confirmText` line read with a ±25-line window that holds an inline marker (`element:button`, `InlineAction`, `properties:`, `action: {`) and a non-empty `params: [`. 16 windows in 5 files, each read by hand:

- `packages/spec/src/ui/action-confirm-params-guard.test.ts` — the inline pin above (the one carrier; flipped here) and `ActionSchema` / `BulkActionDefSchema` fixtures.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-action-copy-templates.test.ts` L111–137 — registered actions and `action:button` rows, not inline actions.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/action-cancel-text.test.ts` L29, `action-copy-template.test.ts` L158, `action-row-update.test.ts` L291–295 — registered actions, a roots helper, and a registered action.

The files changed between `a6441636` and `b3d14150` that carry both keys are registered-action metadata (`platform-objects` identity objects, `plugin-approvals`), generated translation bundles, and ui/spec tests none of which parse an inline action with the pair. Cloud fixtures are not in this repository and were not read. **Disposition unchanged: 0 shipped carriers, 1 spec test pin.**

## Tests

- `action-confirm-params-guard.test.ts`: the "out of reach" inline pin is removed from the boundary block (renamed "the pair guard is scoped by SCHEMA BOUNDARY — the bulk def keeps the pair") and replaced by a new block, "`confirmText` + non-empty `params` is refused on InlineActionSchema too": the refusal (path, `code`, message equal to `ActionSchema`'s), the locale-map form refused, and three accept controls: `description` with no `confirmText`, `confirmText` with no `params`, `confirmText` with `params: []`. The file header names the inline door.

No `dist` in that path (the test imports `./action.zod`).
- Lint consumers: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/validate-action-copy-templates.test.ts src/validate-component-props.test.ts src/validate-component-props-url-target.test.ts src/validate-component-props-row-on-success.test.ts` (after the dogfood closure build): `Test Files 4 passed (4)`, `Tests 207 passed (207)`; VERDICT command-exit 0. The copy-template rule (`validate-action-copy-templates`, its `INLINE_KEYS`) needs no change: it lists copy keys, and this refusal adds none.

**Full dogfood battery** (narrowing arm), on head `65665759`, one locked command: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` (no `OS_TEST_SHARD`, no path): `Test Files 404 passed | 3 skipped (407)`, `Tests 3326 passed | 28 skipped (3354)`, 0 failures; VERDICT command-exit 0 (44m19s held).

## Acceptance notes

- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx` L444 (hand-written) still says "On a registered action, pairing it with a non-empty `params` is *refused*". It stays true but no longer names the inline door; outside this claim's file surface, so left for the docs owner.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` L22 has the same "a registered action" phrasing. True, and it names the remedy; a one-word widening ("A registered or inline action") would be a `skills/**` (Tier H, token-ratcheted) edit, kept out of this Tier S PR.
- The lint copy-template rule's `INLINE_KEYS` (`validate-action-copy-templates.ts`) lists copy keys, not pair rules, so it does not move.

No authorable-surface, api-surface, liveness or dropped-refinements row moves: the refusal adds no key and no export, and `InlineActionSchema` already carried a dropped refinement at every position it is reached from.
